item.title: China Corner
item.description: We examine China’s domestic and external policies; investment flows, strategic, trade and diplomatic relations with Pakistan and its neighbours, the Gulf states and maritime linkages with the Indo-Pacific in the context of Great Power rivalry.

item.title: Why Pakistan is an ‘important partner’?
item.description: A close reading of U.S. South Asia testimony and what it implies for Pakistan’s strategic options across diplomacy, connectivity, and defense.
